new_jobs.jd: **Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.** **The Opportunity** Are you a highly skilled and customer\-oriented professional with strong experience in hyperconverged infrastructure, enterprise virtualization, and production Kubernetes environments? If so, consider joining Nutanix as a Professional Services Consultant in Taiwan. Experience with AI/ML infrastructure and public cloud platforms will be a strong advantage. This role is a key customer\-facing Services position in Taiwan. Due to the local market coverage model, the Professional Services Consultant will be expected to operate in a hybrid responsibility model, covering solution design, hands\-on implementation, migration, technical escalation management, customer advisory, and post\-delivery technical guidance. The minimum expectation is strong hands\-on capability in Nutanix Cloud Infrastructure / NCI and Kubernetes. Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, GPU\-enabled platforms, and public cloud or hybrid cloud environments is highly preferred. **About The Team** You will join the Nutanix Services Delivery team, which is part of a global services organization. You will work closely with regional services leaders, project managers, support teams, engineering teams, partners, sales teams, and systems engineering teams to deliver successful customer outcomes. The role may require travel to customer sites in Taiwan and occasional overseas travel for internal meetings, training, or regional project support. **Your Role** As a Professional Services Consultant, you will deliver Nutanix Professional Services engagements for customers in Taiwan. new_jobs.title: Director, Autonomous Systems / Head of Autonomy BU
new_jobs.jd: **Why Join CHELPIS?** CHELPIS has established core capabilities across **post\-quantum cryptography, cybersecurity software, silicon, secure communications, and edge computing** . We are now extending these capabilities into autonomous and unmanned systems for **defense, critical infrastructure, and other mission\-critical applications** . This is not a role where you inherit a fully mature Business Unit. **You will help build the Autonomy BU with us—from product and technology direction, to the team, and ultimately into a sustainable and growing business.** **About This Role** CHELPIS is extending its PQC and secure computing capabilities into autonomous and unmanned systems, where **AI, autonomous control, edge computing, secure communications, and cybersecurity** must operate as one integrated platform. We are looking for a **Director, Autonomous Systems / Head of Autonomy BU** to lead this effort. This role goes beyond engineering management. You will help define the BU’s technology direction, product roadmap, key programs, and organization, turning technical capabilities into products that can be validated, deployed, and scaled. If you are an experienced **Senior Manager** ready to move beyond leading a single team or function toward broader **product, program, and business responsibilities** , this may be your next step. **Responsibilities** 1\. Define Product and Technology Direction Lead the mid\- to long\-term roadmap for autonomous and unmanned systems, integrating technologies into scalable and product\-ready platforms. Think at the **system level** and make trade\-offs across architecture, technical feasibility, product needs, timelines, and resources. 2\. Lead Cross\-Functional R\&D and System Integration Coordinate multidisciplinary capabilities across embedded systems, robotics, AI, vehicle and flight control, edge computing, communications, and system integration. Initially, the role will lead primarily through **product, program, and cross\-functional technical collaboration** , coordinating internal and external R\&D resources and driving resolution of key technical issues. 3\. Turn Technology into Products Work with PM, BD, customers, and partners to define requirements, milestones, and technical approaches. Drive products from **PoC and system integration through field validation and customer deployment** , while ensuring technologies and engineering knowledge can be reused across future products and programs. 4\. Build the Autonomy BU Team Help shape the organization, workforce plan, key hiring priorities, technical roles, and cross\-functional collaboration model. As the BU grows, progressively assume broader responsibilities for **people management, talent development, performance management, and organizational development** . 5\. Grow into BU Leadership Progressively participate in product roadmap prioritization, R\&D resource planning, strategic customer programs, partnerships, supply\-chain strategy, product economics, commercialization, and annual BU objectives. The goal is to move beyond pure engineering leadership and help build the Autonomy BU into a **scalable and sustainable business** . **Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience in autonomous systems, robotics, unmanned systems, aerospace, defense electronics, intelligent vehicles, embedded systems, or related fields. * Proven people\-management experience at the **Senior Manager or equivalent engineering leadership level** . * 3\+ years of engineering or technical team management experience. * Experience in hiring, talent development, performance management, and/or engineering resource planning. * Experience leading cross\-functional engineering teams or complex multidisciplinary systems. * Ownership of complete products, system integration, or major R\&D programs—not only a single technical module. * Experience across **prototype, PoC, system integration, field validation, and customer delivery** . * Strong system\-level judgment across technology, product, schedule, risk, and resources. * Strong communication skills with executives, customers, engineering teams, and external partners. **Preferred Qualifications** * Unmanned vehicle or autonomous\-system product development experience. * Defense, government, or mission\-critical system experience. * Experience with Edge AI, autonomous navigation, secure communications, or complex embedded systems. * Experience taking products from prototype to deployment, production, or commercialization. * Experience managing multidisciplinary engineering teams. * Experience with product roadmaps, headcount planning, R\&D budgets, or resource allocation. * Experience working with ODM/OEM partners, research institutions, technology partners, or supply chains.

new_jobs.title: AI Sales Engineer - North East Asia
new_jobs.jd: Our Company Teradata is the connected multi\-cloud data platform for enterprise analytics company. Our enterprise analytics solve business challenges from start to scale. Only Teradata gives you the flexibility to handle the massive and mixed data workloads of the future, today. The Teradata Vantage architecture is cloud native, delivered as\-a\-service, and built on an open ecosystem. These design features make Vantage the ideal platform to optimize price performance in a multi\-cloud environment. What You'll Do The AI Sales Engineer is Teradata's regional AI specialist for Asia Pacific and Japan, responsible for helping customers realize the value of enterprise AI through compelling demonstrations, technical workshops, proof\-of\-concept engagements, and architectural guidance. This role partners with both Enterprise and Growth sales teams across APJ, supporting strategic opportunities where AI is a primary evaluation criterion. Rather than owning a specific territory or account list, the AI Sales Engineer serves as a regional expert, driving AI opportunities across multiple markets while building reusable assets and best practices that elevate the technical capabilities of the broader presales organization. Success in this role means becoming the trusted AI advisor for customers and field teams, accelerating AI adoption, enabling successful customer outcomes, contributing to commercial wins, and establishing a scalable AI demonstration framework that can be leveraged across APJ. Who You'll Work With * Reporting to the APJ CSA Lead. * Partnering closely with POD Sales Leaders, Customer Solution Architects (CSAs), Sales Engineers, Product Specialists, and Account Teams across APJ. * Collaborating directly with Teradata's global AI Product Management and Engineering organizations to provide field feedback and influence roadmap priorities. * Supporting customers, partners, analysts, and industry stakeholders across key APJ markets including Australia, Japan, ASEAN, Korea, and Taiwan. What Makes You a Qualified Candidate * 8\+ years of experience in presales, solution architecture, AI engineering, data engineering, or a related customer\-facing technical role. * Demonstrated experience leading enterprise AI proof\-of\-concept engagements from design through delivery and business outcome. * Hands\-on expertise building and presenting AI solutions involving large language models (LLMs), retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, and AI workflow orchestration. * Strong proficiency in Python and SQL with the ability to develop, customize, and present live demonstrations in customer environments. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. What You'll Bring * Experience designing and delivering AI\-focused customer engagements across both existing customer environments and new business opportunities. * Practical knowledge of AI Studio, vector databases, enterprise AI architectures, and modern AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex. * Understanding of enterprise data architecture, governance, performance optimization, and large\-scale analytics platforms. * Knowledge of competitive AI and data platform offerings including Snowflake Cortex, Databricks Mosaic AI, Google Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI Service, Cloudera, IBM, and open\-source AI ecosystems. * Strong communication skills with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both executive and technical audiences. * Experience creating reusable demonstrations, technical assets, enablement programs, and best\-practice documentation. * Ability to influence without authority and support multiple stakeholders across diverse geographies and cultures. * Knowledge of AI use cases across industries such as Financial Services, Retail, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Public Sector, and Government. * Passion for continuous learning and staying current with emerging AI technologies, governance requirements, and market trends. Why We Think You'll Love Teradata We prioritize a people\-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well\-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti\-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are. 회사 소개 Teradata는 엔터프라이즈 분석(Enterprise Analytics)을 위한 연결형 멀티 클라우드 데이터 플랫폼 기업입니다. 당사의 엔터프라이즈 분석 솔루션은 비즈니스 과제를 초기 단계부터 대규모 확장 단계까지 해결할 수 있도록 지원합니다. Teradata만이 미래의 방대하고 다양한 데이터 워크로드를 오늘날 유연하게 처리할 수 있는 역량을 제공합니다. Teradata Vantage 아키텍처는 클라우드 네이티브 방식으로 설계되었으며, 서비스형(as\-a\-service)으로 제공되고, 개방형 생태계를 기반으로 구축되었습니다. 이러한 설계 특성 덕분에 Vantage는 멀티 클라우드 환경에서 비용 대비 성능(Price Performance)을 최적화하는 이상적인 플랫폼입니다. 담당 업무 (What You'll Do) AI Sales Engineer는 Teradata의 아시아 태평양 및 일본(APJ) 지역 AI 전문 담당자로서, 고객이 엔터프라이즈 AI의 가치를 실현할 수 있도록 지원합니다. 이를 위해 설득력 있는 데모, 기술 워크숍, 개념 검증(PoC) 프로젝트, 그리고 아키텍처 가이드를 제공합니다. 이 역할은 APJ 전역의 Enterprise 및 Growth
